description:
A reload mid-recording still sends it to the draft a comment made. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". {{QUERY}} is the query string that opens the diff viewer on that commit in the repository. "It is sent" means data-testid "review-recording-sent" becomes visible (wait up to 30s: sending takes several requests). "Comment on the commit message" means: click the commit message's line (".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20"), fill ".diff-viewer-comment-input" with "Keep the old name.", and click the button named exactly "Add Comment". Call "drafts" counts the drafts the page made (POST /api/conversations/draft) and makes {{DRAFT_ID}} the first one's id; call "chats" returns the JSON list of the paths chat requests went to. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /new?{{QUERY}} and wait for the commit message.
2. Click the start button; the stop button should become visible.
3. Comment on the commit message. The page's URL should come to end with "/c/" and an id, nothing after it (eval /\/c\/[^/?]+$/.test(location.href), expect true). Call "drafts" should return exactly "1".
4. The saved recording names the draft while it is still recording: this eval should come to return exactly ["{{DRAFT_ID}}"]:
new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const open = indexedDB.open("shelley-review-recordings"); open.onerror = () => reject(open.error); open.onsuccess = () => { const all = open.result.transaction("sessions").objectStore("sessions").getAll(); all.onsuccess = () => { open.result.close(); resolve(JSON.stringify(all.result.map((session) => session.conversationId))); }; }; })
5. Without stopping, navigate to /c/{{DRAFT_ID}}?{{QUERY}}. data-testid "review-recording-pending" should contain "Unsent recording".
6. Click data-testid "review-recording-send". It is sent.
7. Call "chats" should return exactly ["/api/conversation/{{DRAFT_ID}}/chat"], and call "drafts" still exactly "1".
